directive.quote: Make one Workshop search tool answer over every list and file with places said, seen, name, written, folding the overlapping tools into it (L101: every consumer moves in the same PR).

old_copy.deleted_with: Source and its test move under the one search owner in the same candidate.

preserve: Retain the original result-search code, SQL statements, ranking, thresholds, page cursors and exported interfaces unchanged.
allowed_deltas: Relocate under the canonical search owner; adjust only relative imports to unchanged shared owners. Keep the relative-floor test beside these modules; do not offer another search descriptor.
banned_substitutions: A replacement ranker or changed threshold
